panels.title: Grafana Explore Queries for Forensic Proof

options.content:
Use **Grafana → Explore → Loki** for forensic proof.

Recommended queries:

```logql
{job="mec-edge"} |= "TAMPER"
{job="mec-edge"} |= "TAMPER" |= "MV-001"
{job="mqtt-bridge"} |= "telemetry_tamper"
{job="mqtt-bridge"} |= "400"
{job="docker-containers"} |= "TAMPER"
```

Metrics show counts. Loki shows searchable event evidence: which vehicle, what payload/path, and what was rejected.

**MQTT valid telemetry**

```bash
docker exec kali-attacker mosquitto_pub -h mosquitto -u mininguser -P miningpass123 \
  -t "mining/vehicles/MV-001/telemetry" \
  -m '{"vehicle_id":"MV-001","speed_kmh":25,"fuel_liters":900,"battery_percent":82,"engine_temp_c":85,"rsrp_dbm":-70,"rtt_ms":20,"packet_loss_percent":0.5,"payload_tons":70,"sinr_db":24,"ul_mbps":18,"dl_mbps":80}'
```

**MQTT tamper telemetry**

```bash
docker exec kali-attacker mosquitto_pub -h mosquitto -u mininguser -P miningpass123 \
  -t "mining/vehicles/MV-001/telemetry" \
  -m '{"vehicle_id":"MV-001","speed_kmh":999,"fuel_liters":2400,"battery_percent":82,"engine_temp_c":85,"rsrp_dbm":-70,"rtt_ms":20,"packet_loss_percent":0.5,"payload_tons":250,"sinr_db":24,"ul_mbps":18,"dl_mbps":80}'
```

**Kali TCP/UDP proof**

```bash
timeout 10s docker exec kali-attacker hping3 -S --flood -p 5000 10.0.0.45
timeout 10s docker exec kali-attacker hping3 --udp --flood -p 2152 10.0.0.22
```
